# Microsoft Fabric Data Engineering

Skills for data engineering in Microsoft Fabric: incremental, idempotent loads into Lakehouse Delta tables from notebooks, with secrets from Azure Key Vault and routine table maintenance. Bundles the read-only Microsoft Learn MCP server for current documentation.

Guidance is grounded in Microsoft Learn documentation for Fabric Data Engineering (checked 2026-10-14). Every Python sample is parsed in the tests, and each scenario includes known-bad answers, such as full-table overwrites or hardcoded passwords, that the tests must reject.

## Skills

| Skill | Use it for | Prerequisites |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [fabric-lakehouse-incremental-merge](skills/fabric-lakehouse-incremental-merge/SKILL.md) | Load data incrementally into Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse Delta tables from a notebook with PySpark: watermark-based extraction, de-duplication, idempotent MERGE upserts, secrets from Azure Key Vault, and table maintenance. | Microsoft Fabric workspace with a Lakehouse and a Fabric Spark runtime that includes Delta Lake (runtime 1.3 or later). A Fabric notebook attached to the target Lakehouse. Azure Key Vault access for any source credentials. |

## Install

```text
# Claude Code
/plugin marketplace add enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills
/plugin install microsoft-fabric@enterprise-agent-skills

# GitHub Copilot CLI
copilot plugin marketplace add enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills
copilot plugin install microsoft-fabric@enterprise-agent-skills

# OpenAI Codex (then open /plugins)
codex plugin marketplace add enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills

# Any Agent Skills compatible agent (Copilot in VS Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and others)
npx skills add enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills --skill fabric-lakehouse-incremental-merge
```
